body:
## Status: FILE ONLY / UNROUTED
Guy authorized redesign scoping and issue filing, not dispatch, implementation, fleet resume, PR, merge or release. No labels or assignees. Visual implementation requires approved prototype evidence and separate routing approval.

## Preserved contract
Accepted V1 panorama + R2 ranch environment + original V1 horse design and corrected grazing anatomy. Native procedural SwiftUI Canvas/Path with distinct/exportable layers; no flattened raster scene, video backdrop, WebView, new engine or service dependency. Same authoritative live model, filters, composite identities, blocked rail and Recent Output destination. Preserve truthful offline/unknown states and accessible operation. Day/Night/Auto environment remains independent of the app's Catppuccin preference. No daemon, SSE, pairing, grant, APNs or release work.

## Design dependency
Refs #455 — owner-selected contract and visual gate. Depends on approved prototype/spec, plus explicit routing. Refs #442/#444; do not duplicate gait #448 or repository ordering #449.

## Small scope
Own presentation tokens/materials for Herd scope trigger, compact status/count controls and the existing FilterScopeSheet when opened from Herd. Reuse one filter model/sheet, not a second filter implementation. Use the approved ranch-context glass/scrim treatment; Board's existing Catppuccin treatment and general Settings Appearance stay unchanged. This is not a whole-app recolor.

## Source
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/FleetViews.swift#L1494-L1535
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/FleetViews.swift#L2451-L2465
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/Herd/HerdView.swift#L125-L151

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Trigger, HUD status/count controls, sheet header/rows/selection/footer form a coherent approved Day and Night ranch treatment; no mismatched light/dark text inherited blindly from app flavor.
- [ ] Day and Night remain usable under all four app flavors; changing environment never rewrites global theme preference.
- [ ] Native glass where available plus deliberate older-OS/Reduce Transparency/high-contrast fallback; preserve deployment target and contrast on bright sky and dark field.
- [ ] Existing host/repo selections, counts, offline/connecting/key-mismatch states, Reset and accessibility labels remain authoritative and behaviorally identical.
- [ ] One shared sheet receives explicit presentation context. Board-launched filters and unrelated Settings/Recent Output surfaces do not regress or inherit leaked Herd styling.
- [ ] Native screenshots include actual open sheet over actual Herd background in Day/Night, scrolled content and large text. Physical iPhone proof required before claiming translucency/theme fidelity; source wiring alone is insufficient.
- [ ] Focused interaction/presentation-context tests and native/CI gates pass. Serialize shared FleetViews edits with shell/preference children.
title: Herd: align floating controls and filter sheet with ranch Day/Night context
